tips.text: Weapon Fragments and Matiki's cage are randomized each league — Kingsmarch's dialogue tells you which islands.
Pre-organize your stash on Standard before a league starts to save time in the first town.
Aim for roughly 5 hours to clear the whole campaign.

objectives.text: Talk to Doryani, then Alva (with Rog)
Talk to Tujen, accept his quest
Talk to Farrow, accept his quest
notes: Unlocks the 13 Ancient Runes (weapon-type-specific), crafted at Remnant encounters
Farrow does nothing further here for now — his quest only completes later, at the Plunder's Point Deserted Post

objectives.text: Talk to Makoru on the ship, choose a destination
notes: Rog doesn't handle the boat charter this league — Makoru does
Weapon Fragments and Matiki are randomized across the four islands each league — Kingsmarch dialogue tells you which

objectives.text: Petrified Pirate on the coast
Shark Pit → kill the Great White One
Hand the Shark Fin to Kaimana to complete Tribal Medicine
notes: Kaimana is at Ngakanu early, or on the docks after Tavakai if the islands are already corrupted
objectives.reward: Uncut Gem Lvl 11 (choice) + permanent Tukuama blessing

objectives.text: Crabshell Cavern → kill Clawcrunch
Enter Singing Caverns
Beckoning Clam → Humming Pearl (give to Rog)
Kill Diamora, Song of Death (may drop a Fragment)
Talk to The Hooded One, TP to town
Talk to Ange → Shoreline Hideout
Clear the hideout, talk to Ange
Corpse Nest (Impaled Karui)
Kill Scourge of the Skies (may drop a Fragment)
Talk to The Hooded One, TP and sail next
Kill mobs until the Chapel Key drops
Open the Chapel, kill Forael, use the Goddess of Justice
Enter Solitary Confinement
Kill The Prisoner (may drop a Fragment)
Talk to The Hooded One, sail to Isle of Kin
Flayed Sailor near the shore
Doomed Mine (an abandoned delving site — Fossilised Formation)
Beast Pen
Kill Mimok the Enslaved
Primal Arena → kill the Blind Beast
Enter Volcanic Warrens
Volcanic Nest → Magma Twins
notes: Kill order matters: Lightning first → Ruby Ring; Fire first → Topaz Ring

objectives.text: Kill Krutog, Lord of Kin (the Tyrant Throne)
Click the cage, free Matiki, then TP to Kingsmarch
Talk to Matiki at the well, click the well
notes: Matiki waits at the well itself, not in town

objectives.text: Chest behind the waterfall
Complete the 3 Tests: Fire, Nature, Cold
Silent Hall altar (Pay Respects), talk to Navali
Enter Halls of the Dead
Trial of Ngakanu (3 tests in a clover-leaf), loot the Tattoos
notes: Choose +5% Fire/Cold/Lightning Resistance (recommended for most builds) or +5 Str/Dex/Int

objectives.text: Fight Yama the White (low life pool — easy stun)
Enter Trial of the Ancestors
Talk to Navali and Hinekora
TP, sail to Kedge Bay
Dead Man's Chest / Smuggler's Stash
Abandoned Ship
Tidal Cay → kill Tombgrowl
Doran, the Deft — near the entrance
notes: A challenging, highly mobile Rogue Exile

objectives.text: Enter Journey's End
Talk to Tujen
Kill Captain Harlin, loot the Verisium
TP to start, talk to Freya Hartlin
Town → Dannig → Verisium Spikes, then return and talk to Freya
Totem → kill Omniphobia
Talk to Tujen in town for the reward
Give all 4 Torn Map Pieces to Makoru, sail to Dannig, start the Expedition
notes: Only unlocks once all 4 Torn Maps are turned in — from Whakapanu, Shrike, Isle of Kin, and Kedge Bay

objectives.text: Reach the Deserted Post, summon Farrow
notes: The most-skipped leg of the Runeseeker chain — skip it and you forgo Ancient Runes entirely

objectives.text: Talk to Missionari Lorandis, follow, destroy the shield
Evening / Morning Bells
Kill Torvian, enter The Excavation
notes: Let Torvian throw stones at the 2 priests above to break the fight open

objectives.text: Kill Benedictus (the Precursor Forge), talk to The Hooded One
Excavated Cache at the checkpoint
Sail to Ngakanu
Abyss → Abyssal Depths
Mad Butcher in the large hut
Enter Heart of the Tribe
Meeting House has chests to loot
Kill Tavakai (Final Act 4 Boss), talk to him
Return, talk to The Hooded One — unlocks the Interludes
